evaluation_scope: Exhaustive for listed categories within ROI; other categories are unscored

roi_completion.definition: QA-passed source-visible pixels inside ROI, excluding ignore regions. Residual is a subset of unassigned, not additive. Not GT pixel correctness.

definitions.semantic_coverage: Union of QA-passed source-visible instance/terrain masks over nontransparent source pixels; predicted quality, not GT recall.
definitions.predicted_semantic_coverage: All assigned source masks including review candidates; excludes residual.
definitions.unassigned_ratio: Pixels without QA-passed semantics, including residual. Not additive with residual.
definitions.background_pixel_ratio: QA-passed visible terrain pixels; excludes residual and generated completion.
definitions.asset_ready: Persisted base cutout and segmentation, QA pass, no unresolved content/boundary review; optional HD excluded.
definitions.quality: GT recall, precision, final duplicate/fragmentation/mask quality are unavailable until Benchmark evaluation.
definitions.reconstruction: Pixel fidelity only; residual may produce 1.0 with low semantic coverage.

metric_definitions.matching: Confidence-ordered category-aware one-to-one IoU matching within ROI; duplicate predictions also lower precision.
metric_definitions.duplicates: Unmatched predictions overlapping an already matched GT at IoU threshold / predictions.
metric_definitions.fragmentation: GT instances containing at least two distinct nonoverlapping partial boxes / instance GT; heuristic, not amodal GT.
metric_definitions.size: BBox area / original scene area; no resizing-dependent thresholds.
metric_definitions.mask_quality: Visible-mask metrics conditional on a matched, mask-annotated GT; missing predicted masks score zero. Unmatched GT reported as misses.
metric_definitions.semantic_coverage: QA-passed visible pixel union; GT semantic-region scores are separate and unavailable without mask GT.

validity.reason: truncated/mock/draft GT; not an acceptance gate
